project.name: Primitive
release_notes: Browser Exchange can bind a trusted application API origin and its configured CSRF header while retaining the original same-origin executor.
CSRF tokens and standard idempotency keys are supplied per request, never retained by the client. Native CORS, cookies, TLS and fetch remain authoritative; redirects are refused.

Browser policy admission rejects credential-bearing origins, unsafe header roles and changed header spellings. Real WebKit and Chrome proof covers cross-origin mutation, unchanged same-origin behavior and exact JSON bodies.
